title: Charred Tiger Prawns Pad Thai
description: A vegan twist on the classic Thai dish, using plant-based 'prawns' made from tiger nuts and charred to perfection.

ingredients.name: Charred vegetables
ingredients.notes: Such as bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms

ingredients.name: Pad see ew noodles
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a vegan version

ingredients.name: Vegan tamarind paste
ingredients.notes: You can make your own or buy it at a store

ingredients.name: Vegan fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Make sure it's free from animal products

ingredients.name: Vegan palm sugar
ingredients.notes: You can substitute with coconut sugar

ingredients.name: Vegan soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Make sure it's free from animal products

ingredients.name: Vegan oil
ingredients.notes: Choose a neutral-tasting oil like canola

instructions: 1. Cook the pad see ew noodles according to package instructions.
2. In a blender or food processor, blend the tiger nuts, charred vegetables, tamarind paste, fish sauce, palm sugar, ginger, and garlic until you get a sticky paste.
3. Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Add the blended paste to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
5. Add the cooked noodles to the wok and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
6. Season with soy sauce and serve hot.
7. Garnish with chopped scallions and sesame seeds, if desired.
